scope: client board-open retry until a complete snapshot arrives
snapshot and board-open diagnostics across client/server
regression checks for retry coverage and patch reproducibility
checks: Client tracks each open physical board and repeats the idempotent Open request every two seconds until SnapshotEnd marks that board ready; retries stop when the board closes or the connection ends.
The server Open path is idempotent for an existing visitor and repeats a fresh snapshot on each retry, so a missed/incomplete snapshot can recover without task-state transfer.
Client logs connection detection, handshake, first open, snapshot begin/end, and listing synchronization; server logs Hello, first board open, and snapshot contents at debug level.
The source checker now fails if the open-board snapshot retry is removed.
The complete native patch still applies to the pinned clean upstream commit.
limits: Windows/MSVC build and live two-client game test have not yet been rerun for this retry change.
